# DIVO Autos Ltd

Independent car repair garage in Camberley, Surrey. Trading since 2010 (Companies House 07392363).
Rated 4.8 out of 5 from 117 Google reviews.

Address: Unit 7C, Bridge Trade Park, Bridge Road, Camberley GU15 2QR
Phone: 01276 24141
Email: divoautos@gmail.com
Hours: Monday to Friday 8:30am to 6:00pm, Saturday 8:30am to 2:00pm, Sunday closed. Night drop available.
Areas served: Camberley, Frimley, Sandhurst, Bagshot, Blackwater, Yateley, Lightwater.

## Services
MOT testing (Class 4 and Class 7), interim and full servicing, computer diagnostics, general repairs, brakes, clutches, timing belts, exhausts, auto electrics, welding, tyres and wheel balancing. All work guaranteed.

## Published guide prices
Diagnostics £30. MOT Class 4 £40, Class 7 £58 (VAT exempt). Interim service from £75 + VAT. Full service from £140 + VAT. Brakes from £78 + VAT. Timing belt from £180 labour. Clutch from £200 labour. Tyres from £60. Welding from £50. Labour £50 per hour + VAT. Discounts on service + MOT packages.
